title: 第25章 季小姐我家主子的命更金贵第26章 是我救了你以后可要好好报答我
slug: 穿成女配弹幕让我又争又抢
content_zh:
季月挑眉，好奇的问鬼煞：“你这次怎么混进天山宗的？”
“托你们天山宗一个长得有几分姿色的瘸子的福，身残志坚跑下山，也不知道是不是山下有他相好的。”鬼煞感叹的说道。
季月仅一秒猜出是沈宴，她追问：“瘸子手里是不是拿着书信？”
鬼煞连连点头：“是啊，你认识他？”
季月脸色沉下来，眸中闪过厉色，沈宴这个狗东西，一点都不老实，和云茵联手搞她。
等她看看三皇子那边情况，再回来收拾他！
季月和鬼煞匆匆下山后，谢长歌来到弟子院找沈宴。
“沈宴，我跟你说的话才几天，你就忘了？”谢长歌面无表情的坐到床沿边。
沈宴将双腿盖得严严实实，脸色讨好的解释道：“我没去月华院转，也没去找季月。”
谢长歌拿出几张信纸，另一只手强硬地扣住沈宴的脖子，将他的脸扯到信纸面前。
“看看？因为你，袁师弟挨了五十大板，在影洞得待到过收徒大典才能出来。”
“他皮糙肉厚，倒也无所谓。可季师妹身娇体弱，从小到大，师尊连她手掌心都没打过一次，却要她待在影洞三天！毒虫咬到她怎么办？她得多疼啊？”
沈宴看完信纸上的内容，脸色瞬间变得惨白，惊愕地说道：
“我、我要是知道上面写的是这个，我绝不会交给师尊的。”
谢长歌蓦地发出一记阴沉的笑音，“看来沈师弟的腿不能好，一好就到处乱跑。”
随从愁眉苦脸的跟季月讲：
“昨晚公子房中发出巨大的响动，我担心出事，在门外问公子，好半天公子才说没事，说有老鼠钻到他屋中，被他打死了。
可今日起来，公子就不对劲了，一个劲地念叨要娶云小姐。”
“怎么听着像中邪了？”季月喃喃道。
鬼煞摇了摇头，语气肯定，“绝不可能，我就是鬼，我都不敢靠近他，他身上有一股很强的正气，邪祟根本不敢近身。”

季月忽然想到什么，吩咐鬼煞：“你去看看昨天那个邪修的尸体还在不在？”
随从看着季月和空气交谈，脸上露出古怪的神色，她不会也中邪了吧？
鬼煞化作黑烟消散在原地，很快，他又回来了，凝重地说道：“不见了，连一点血迹都没留下。”
普通尸体会被山间野兽啃食，邪修的身体不同，早被邪气侵蚀，内里都是虫子，野兽根本不敢靠近。
她和鬼煞对视一眼，异口同声地说道：“他没死！”
季月意识到事态的严重性，她快步到堂厅，诸葛远舟被绑在椅子上，身体挣扎得四条椅子腿发出咯吱咯吱的响。
“我要娶云小姐，我要娶云小姐……”
诸葛远舟脸色发青，双眼无神，口中不停地重复着这句话。
季月哪还不明白，邪修和云茵就是一伙的，昨天邪修要杀她，也是受云茵指使。
她翻了下系统商城，没有合适的道具，便主动问弹幕：“诸葛远舟怎么了？”
【无能的丈夫：中蛊了，解药嘛，是云茵的血，你懂得，女主浑身都是宝的设定。】
content_en:
Ji Yue raised her eyebrows and asked Gui Sha curiously: "How did you get into the Tianshan Sect this time?"
"Thanks to a pretty lame man from your Tianshan Sect, I ran down the mountain with a weak body and a strong mind. I don't know if there is a lover at the foot of the mountain." Gui Sha said with a sigh.
Ji Yue guessed it was Shen Yan in just one second, and she asked: "Is the lame man holding a letter in his hand?"
Gui Sha nodded repeatedly: "Yes, do you know him?"
Ji Yue's face darkened, and a stern look flashed in her eyes. Shen Yan, this bitch, was not honest at all, and he teamed up with Yun Yin to get her.
Wait until she sees what's going on with the Third Prince before she comes back to deal with him!
After Ji Yue and Gui Sha hurried down the mountain, Xie Changge came to the disciples' courtyard to find Shen Yan.
"Shen Yan, it's only been a few days since I told you, and you've forgotten what I said?" Xie Changge sat on the edge of the bed expressionlessly.
Shen Yan covered his legs tightly and explained with a flattering expression: "I didn't go to Yuehua Courtyard, nor did I look for Ji Yue."
Xie Changge took out some pieces of letter paper, grabbed Shen Yan's neck forcefully with his other hand, and pulled his face to the letter paper.
"See? Because of you, Junior Brother Yuan suffered fifty blows. He can only come out of the Shadow Cave until the apprenticeship ceremony."
"It doesn't matter that he is rough-skinned and thick-skinned. But Junior Sister Ji is delicate and frail. Since she was a child, Master has never even slapped her palm once, but he wants her to stay in the Shadow Cave for three days! What will happen if a poisonous insect bites her? How much pain will she have?"
After Shen Yan read the contents on the letter, his face instantly turned pale and he said in shock:
"I-if I had known that this was what was written on it, I would never have handed it to Master."
Xie Changge suddenly let out a gloomy laugh, "It seems that Junior Brother Shen's legs can't be healed. Once healed, he runs around everywhere."
The follower told Ji Yue with a sad face:
"There was a huge noise in the young master's room last night. I was worried that something had happened, so I asked the young master outside the door. It took a long time before the young master said it was okay. He said that a mouse got into his house and he killed it.
But when I woke up today, something felt wrong. He kept talking about marrying Miss Yun. "
"Why does it sound like someone is possessed?" Ji Yue murmured.
Gui Sha shook his head and said with certainty, "It's absolutely impossible. I am a ghost and I don't dare to get close to him. He has a strong righteousness in him, and evil spirits don't dare to get close."
Ji Yue suddenly thought of something and told Gui Sha: "Go and see if the body of the evil cultivator yesterday is still there?"
The entourage watched Ji Yue talking to Qiu Qiao with a strange look on her face. Could she also be possessed by evil spirits?
The ghost turned into black smoke and dissipated on the spot. Soon, he came back and said solemnly: "It's gone, not even a trace of blood is left."
Ordinary corpses will be eaten by wild beasts in the mountains. The bodies of evil cultivators are different. They have long been eroded by evil spirits and are filled with bugs. Wild beasts dare not approach them at all.
She and Gui Sha looked at each other and said in unison: "He's not dead!"
Ji Yue realized the seriousness of the situation and hurried to the hall. Zhuge Yuanzhou was tied to a chair, and his body struggled so much that the four chair legs creaked.
"I want to marry Miss Yun, I want to marry Miss Yun..."
Zhuge Yuanzhou's face turned blue, his eyes were dull, and he kept repeating these words.
Ji Yue still doesn't understand that Xie Xiu and Yun Yin are in the same group. Yesterday Xie Xiu wanted to kill her, but he was also instigated by Yun Yin.
She browsed the system mall and found no suitable props, so she took the initiative to ask the barrage: "What's wrong with Zhuge Yuanzhou?"
[Incompetent Husband: I've been poisoned. The antidote is Yun Yin's blood. You know, the heroine is full of treasures. 】
